```{r}
merged <- merge(m1, y = c(m3,m4,m5,m7,m8,m13,m14,m16,m20))
```

```{r}
merged[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(merged, pattern = "^mt-")
```

```{r}
merged
```

```{r}
png(filename="./pre qc violin plot.png", width=18, height=10, units="cm", res=300)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
merged_filtered <- subset(merged, subset = nCount_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 10000 & percent.mt < 5)
```

```{r}
merged_filtered
```

```{r}
png(filename="./post qc violin plot.png", width = 18, height = 10, units = "cm", res = 300)
VlnPlot(merged_filtered, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
SaveH5Seurat(merged_filtered, filename = "./scrublet step/merged_postQC.h5Seurat")
```

```{r}
Convert("./scrublet step/merged_postQC.h5Seurat", dest = "h5ad")
```


```{r}
#### Load in doublet output
scrub = read.csv('./scrublet step/scrublet-scores/all.csv',header=T,row.names=1)
```

```{r}
merged_filtered@meta.data$scrublet_score = scrub$scrublet_score
merged_filtered@meta.data$scrublet_cluster_score = scrub$scrublet_cluster_score
merged_filtered@meta.data$bh_pval = scrub$bh_pval
```

```{r}
merged_filtered$sample <- factor(x = merged_filtered$sample, levels = c('4', '7', '20', '1', '13', '14', '3', '5', '8', '16'))
```

```{r}
png(filename="./scrublet sample violin plot.png", width = 25, height = 10, units = "cm", res = 300)
VlnPlot(merged_filtered, group.by = "sample", features = "scrublet_score", pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()
dev.off()
```

```{r}
merged_filtered
```

```{r}
merged_filtered <- subset(
  x = merged_filtered,
  subset = scrublet_score < 0.25
)
```

```{r}
merged_filtered
```

```{r}
VlnPlot(merged_filtered, group.by = "sample", features = "scrublet_score", pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()
```




```{r}
saveRDS(merged_filtered, "./merged_postQC_doubletRemoval.rds")
```
